About the Role

At Cogniify, we help enterprises gain critical visibility into how sensitive data moves across modern platforms. We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst specializing in Data Movement and AI Governance .

In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex telemetry and actionable risk intelligence. You will analyze signals from DLP, endpoints, and GenAI systems to identify emerging risk patterns, shadow IT, and unauthorized data exfiltration in the age of modern cloud workflows and LLMs.

Key Responsibilities

BI & Risk Dashboard Development (30%): Design and maintain interactive dashboards (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) to track data movement and exfiltration patterns, including personal GitHub usage, unauthorized cloud storage (Dropbox/Box), and removable media activity.

Data Analysis & AI Telemetry (25%): Ingest and analyze GenAI usage telemetry to identify PII leaks in AI prompts or unauthorized third-party tool usage. You will use advanced SQL to correlate software installs with malicious web activity.

Data Modeling & Signal Correlation (15%): Develop reporting data models that combine user behavior with endpoint telemetry. You’ll optimize SQL queries to detect early indicators of account hijacking, malicious insider behavior, and shadow AI usage.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Governance (15%): Work with security and platform teams to translate business risks into technical specifications. You’ll define KPIs for "signal quality" and help stakeholders understand the effectiveness of data protection policies.

Data Quality & Documentation (10%): Perform rigorous validation of log and event datasets. You will document data definitions and transformation rules to ensure reporting accuracy in highly sensitive security contexts.

Automation & Process Improvement (5%): Automate recurring security reporting workflows and improve the refresh cycles of high-priority risk alerts.

Qualifications & Experience

The skills required for this specialty occupation are typically acquired through a Bachelor’s degree in a technical field plus relevant experience.

Education: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field.
Master’s degree in Analytics or a quantitative field is highly preferred.

Experience: * A minimum of 5+ years of experience in data analytics, risk analytics, or a related specialty field.
Equivalent Experience: We also welcome candidates with a Bachelor’s degree + 5 years of experience, or a Master’s degree + 3 years of experience.

Technical Skills:
Advanced SQL: Expert-level ability to perform joins, aggregations, and subqueries on large-scale log, event, or telemetry datasets.

BI Mastery: Deep experience building dashboards in Amazon QuickSight, Tableau, or Power BI .

Domain Knowledge (Nice to Have): Familiarity with DLP, endpoint telemetry, GitHub/CI-CD logs, or GenAI governance/LLM monitoring.

Ideal Candidate

You are naturally curious about the "how" and "where" of data movement. You enjoy turning noisy, high-volume telemetry into clear intelligence that helps organizations stay secure as user behavior evolves with GenAI.

Visa Sponsorship: This position qualifies as a Specialty Occupation . Cogniify is committed to supporting global talent and is able to provide visa sponsorship for qualified applicants.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Job Purpose: Casting Networks is seeking an inquisitive individual with an inherent affinity for data of all sorts. Like numbers and puzzles? The Business Intelligence Analyst will transform market and business trends into meaningful, actionable insights driving business growth and efficiency. A bright, highly solutions-oriented and hands-on technologist consumed by the notion that information can transform business results. In this role you will conduct analytical studies to provide results and recommendations to Leadership for department and enterprise-wide strategic initiatives. A successful candidate in this space will have the ability to effectively problem solve, move quickly, think critically and have a background in statistics, analytics or business intelligence application. The work will focus on delivering insights and analysis to drive decision making for cross-departmental units such as Finance, Marketing and Product. Casting Networks may look like a typical SaaS company, but under the surface we're a micro-economy that runs on data. We’re still in our early stages of data vaulting and insights mining – so this opportunity is ideal for a real self-starter wanting to have impact from the start! From finance, to marketing, to product, every department at Casting Networks will rely on data to make business decisions. As a business intelligence analyst at Casting Networks you'll work with teams across the organization to understand data needs, develop robust business intelligence data sources, build reports and visualizations to answer key business questions, and contribute to our strategy for data collection. As a key member of our decision-making process, you’ll be solving problems and enabling our organization through data visualization, to figure out tomorrow’s puzzle. As we evolve, so will your responsibility. You’ll never answer the same question twice. You will dig into the data, driving insight that will directly help us win our market. In addition, you'll work closely with our data pipeline team to ensure that our data sources are complete, consistent, and reliable. Duties and Responsibilities: Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis relating to operational functions, workflow, processes, and other business-related issues. Obtain quantitative and qualitative data of business processes to analyze, determine and promote data driven decisions Analyze and evaluate competitor data and industry trends to understand current business unit competitive posture Design and document dashboards, reports, and thresholds to alert business units to monitor business status and fluctuations Collect and analyze data; synthesize results of analyses, develop and make recommendations and alternatives based on the full spectrum of internal/external considerations Use data warehousing/business intelligence toolsets to gather, store, and provide access to data in assist management decision making Collaborate with business units and Senior Leadership to conduct needs assessment to support organization strategies, tactics, and learning solutions that support business unit objectives Prepare data analysis and forecasts and help automate data collection Automate digital data collection and analysis Liaise between the data warehouse team, marketing and executives Create business requirements and related BI documentation Qualifications: Bachelor's degree with 3 to 5 years’ entertainment/tech industry experience or equivalent experience Experience with common data science toolkits, such as Python, Numpy, R, etc. Excellence in at least one of these is highly desirable Experience with data visualization tools, such as Tableau, GGplot, MS PowerBI, etc . Proficiency in using query languages such as SQLExperience with NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase Good applied statistics skills, such as distributions, statistical testing, regression, etc. Extensive experience in the application of statistical methods, mathematical techniques, forecasting, cost-benefit analysis and related analytical tools Skill interpreting, extrapolating and interpolating data for statistical research and modeling Skill analyzing statistics and reports to determine business performance and trends Advanced verbal and written communication skills; ability to explain complex data and methodologies to varied audience Advanced database and presentation software skills Advanced Excel skills

Position: Business Intelligence Analyst

Type: Full-time

Location: Coronado, CA

Travel: Approximately three to four trips annually

**Contingent Upon Award**

Position Summary: The Business Intelligence Analyst serves as the principal analytical and data management professional supporting the Naval Special Warfare Leader Assessment Program. This position is responsible for collecting, managing, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting assessment data that informs leadership development decisions across Naval Special Warfare. The analyst develops data models, dashboards, predictive analytics, and performance reports while maintaining Government-controlled databases and stakeholder reporting processes. This position directly supports the Naval Special Warfare Leader Assessment Program Manager and supervises the Administrative Support Assistant to ensure successful execution of program requirements.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Collect business intelligence data from Naval Special Warfare and Naval Special Warfare Leader Assessment Program sources.

• Develop and maintain key performance indicators and performance metrics.

• Analyze data and provide actionable recommendations to leadership.

• Manage Government-controlled databases and data flow processes.

• Develop predictive models using regression, statistical methodologies, and analytical software.

• Collect, process, and analyze large datasets from leadership development programs.

• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations.

• Present analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Prepare quarterly analytic and performance reports.

• Maintain Naval Special Warfare Leader Assessment Program registration and survey systems.

• Coordinate with stakeholders throughout Naval Special Warfare leadership development communities.

• Supervise the Administrative Support Assistant.

• Serve as Naval Special Warfare Leader Assessment Program Moderator when requested.

Required Qualifications:

• US Citizen

• Valid U.S. driver’s license

• Must hold an active Secret Security Clearance

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Clear and effective verbal and written communication

• Bachelor's degree in Business Intelligence Analysis, Statistics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Minimum five (5) years of experience developing customer-directed scoring systems, assessment templates, applications, or related business intelligence solutions with real-time usability and reporting capabilities.

• Minimum five (5) years of experience presenting performance summaries, analyzing performance trends, and developing performance deliverables supporting assessment programs.

• Demonstrated experience in at least two projects involving quantitative and/or qualitative data analysis resulting in executive-level recommendations or decision support products.

• Demonstrated experience applying at least two data collection and analysis best practices, including stakeholder management, real-time data collection, data accuracy, analytical tools, and actionable visualization techniques.

• Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Business Intelligence tools such as Microsoft Power BI or Tableau.

Highly Desired Qualifications:

• Predictive analytics experience.

• Machine learning experience.

• Data mining expertise.

• Statistical modeling experience.

• Advanced data visualization capability.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience briefing senior military leaders or executives.

Physical Demands and Work Environment: While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk, listen, and write. The employee frequently is required to use foot/ankle motions, hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is required to stand, walk, sit; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to be the best qualified for the position and successfully perform the functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made (if possible) to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

  

We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst to join our Corporate Finance team, based out of our Santa Clara office. Our organization’s overarching responsibilities are to deliver the highest caliber of relevant financial and business information that is both informative and measurable, enabling effective decision-making at all levels of the Company and improving our financial performance. This critical role within the Finance organization requires strong Power BI expertise, advanced data and modeling skills, and the ability to deliver scalable reporting and analytics solutions. We are looking for an energetic, collaborative, and execution-oriented professional with strong communication skills who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

  

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards for Finance leadership, translating complex Corporate Finance data into clear, decision-ready information.
* Own reporting and analytics for the company's consolidated P&L, delivering enterprise-wide financial visibility and insight to senior Finance leadership.
* Design and deliver scalable data solutions that support business reporting and analytics needs, including Databricks data pipelines, reporting layers, semantic models, financial calculations, and reusable metrics.
* Leverage approved AI tools to accelerate data preparation, modeling, analysis, visualization, testing, and documentation.
* Partner with Finance leaders and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective, well-governed BI solutions.
* Ensure BI solutions are reliable, secure, and optimized for performance, and support ongoing operations through data quality monitoring, refresh management, troubleshooting, and maintenance.

  

**What we need to see:**

* 8+ years of experience designing and developing enterprise BI and analytics solutions, including at least 3 years working within or directly supporting a Finance organization.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Finance, or a related field.
* Strong Power BI expertise, including DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, performance optimization, and report and dashboard development.
* Strong SQL skills and working proficiency in Python for data transformation, analysis, and automation.
* Experience designing data models and developing ETL/ELT pipelines using enterprise databases and modern data platforms, including Databricks, Snowflake, or Microsoft Fabric.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex) to accelerate BI and analytics delivery.
* Good communication, ownership, and project management skills, with the ability to partner across Finance, business, and technical teams while maintaining high standards for data quality and completeness.

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Hands-on experience supporting FP&A processes, including revenue and P&L reporting, gross margin analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and financial close reporting.
* Demonstrable experience developing executive-level Power BI reports and dashboards that communicate financial performance, trends, and business drivers.
* Experience building AI agents or reusable AI skills that improve BI and Finance workflows, including data validation, reporting, and dashboard maintenance.

  

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family [www.nvidiabenefits.com/](http://www.nvidiabenefits.com/)

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 128,000 USD – 201,250 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and [benefits](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/benefits/).

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

  

NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing. Today, our AI infrastructure powers global intelligence, transforming every industry.

Learn more about [NVIDIA](https://nam11.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nvidia.com%2Fobject%2Fabout-nvidia.html%23sthash.qlXKW56Q.dpuf&data=05%7C01%7Chozkan%40nvidia.com%7Cf442a08620ed4ab9afb108db18e6d308%7C43083d15727340c1b7db39efd9ccc17a%7C0%7C0%7C638131151878484303%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=DjpWGYWzl3J2uwSP6woYwjdRi52yvWRVeAijKer9u%2Fk%3D&reserved=0).

The NVIDIA Revenue Marketing Team is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst! We transform sophisticated data into actionable insights for the CMO and collaborators across Marketing, Sales, Developer, Finance, and Product. This role combines the organized problem-solving approach of a management consultant with the technical expertise of a hands-on analyst. We need an AI native, incorporating AI throughout the analytical process, developing reusable solutions, and ensuring the accuracy and business impact of the outcomes.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Partner with senior leaders to frame business questions, challenge assumptions, and prioritize analytical work based on business impact. Translate leadership priorities into actionable plans and guide initiatives from recommendation to adoption and measurement.
* Synthesize complex marketing, sales, and developer insights into concise executive briefs, presentations, and dashboards that explain what is happening, why it matters, and what to do next. Tailor the narrative and level of detail to the audience.
* Present recommendations to senior executives and lead discussions that advise strategy, investment, and execution. Explain assumptions and tradeoffs, incorporate feedback, and build agreement on decisions and next steps.
* Examine campaign results, account journeys, funnel conversion, pipeline, and revenue attribution to identify growth opportunities and recommend where to focus resources.
* Apply statistical methods to test hypotheses, distinguish meaningful changes from noise, and assess the likely success of proposed actions.
* Develop AI-assisted and agentic workflows that accelerate analysis, anomaly detection, and reporting. Validate outputs against source data, protect critical information, and evaluate whether the resulting insights positively guide decisions.

  

**What we need to see:**

* 8+ years in management consulting at a strategy consulting firm or similar, synthesizing analysis and advising senior executives. A degree or equivalent experience in Business, Economics, Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
* Proven experience synthesizing complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior executives, presenting and facilitating discussions in leadership meetings, and influencing cross-functional decisions through adoption and measurable outcomes.
* An AI-native working approach, proven through analytical workflows or tools you have built and used, with an ability to evaluate generated code and conclusions, identify errors, and apply human judgment.
* Strong analytical judgment in statistical analysis, experimentation, attribution limitations, and the distinction between correlation and causation. Ability to structure ambiguous questions and explain the implications and limitations of findings.
* Experience building dashboards, data models, and visualizations in modern AI-first BI tools, with an emphasis on clear data storytelling, usability, and data quality.
* Shown ownership of analytical projects, strong documentation, and experience influencing cross-functional teams while delivering independently in a constantly evolving environment.

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* A track record of influencing senior executive decisions through presentations and business reviews, with examples of recommendations adopted and measurable business outcomes.
* SQL and practical Python familiarity, with hands-on experience exploring large datasets in a modern cloud analytics platform.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Marketo, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, or Amplitude, and with account engagement, pipeline progression, lifecycle measurement, and proactive usage of social listening data.
* Examples of AI agents, analytical web apps, or automated intelligence briefs embraced by business users, with evidence of improved speed, accuracy, or decision making.
* Experience with forecasting, marketing incrementality, or developer ecosystem analysis, including product usage and publicly available engagement data.

Position Title : Business Intelligence Analyst II

Location : Coronado, CA

Clearance required : SECRET

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

• Collaborate with stakeholders to define key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics while managing the flow of information, so data is analyzed, summarized and routed to the proper stakeholders in a timely manner.

• Store data in Government controlled databases; establish operational procedures to utilize the database and provide technical support as required.

• Analyze data to identify any trends that could impact strategies; utilize the results of the analysis to support recommendations for action to improve or grow the program.

• Conduct quantitative and/or qualitative data analysis and evaluations to determine the effectiveness of operations and assessment processes used to inform decision makers on current trends and optimization opportunities.

• Utilizing data, apply commonly used regression algorithms, statistical software, and computer programs to generate predictive models for classification, data normalization and regularization.

• Establish and maintain an efficient, user-friendly, interactive registration and peer and subordinate survey collection system to streamline these processes.

• Collect, process, and analyze large datasets from NSW’s Continuum of Leadership Development Program (CLD), coordinating with CLD personnel as directed by the Program Manager.

• Develop and maintain complex data models, reports, and dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

• Create compelling visualizations that effectively communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholder audiences.

• Work with a variety of people, both internally and externally, to stay aware of trends in leadership assessment among other Navy communities.

• Prepare quarterly analytic and performance reports to include depictions of participant performance, assessment trend analysis, and summaries of data.

• Supervise the Administrative Support Assistant (ASA).

• Act as the Moderator during panel milestone interviews if requested by the Government. The role of the Moderator is to ensure continuity among iterations by adhering to prepared scripts for all competency interviews, and readiness for milestone deliberations. The Moderator will enforce the rules of engagement specified for both panelists and participants. This role requires situational awareness, anticipation, discretion, and tact. The Moderator is not an assessor of milestone readiness.
• Minimum of 5 years’ experience in developing customer-directed scoring and assessment templates and other applications with easy utilization features and display in real time.

• Minimum of 5 years’ experience presenting performance summaries, analyzing performance trends, and developing future performance deliverables for assessment programs.

• Demonstrating capability in at least two instances to fully comprehend collected data, analyze through quantitative and/or qualitative techniques, and present summaries to facilitate executive decisions.

• Demonstrating through work experience at least 2 of the following best practices in data collection: understanding the often-competing needs of a variety of community stakeholders; appreciating the importance of accurate data collection in real time; mastering analytical tools to best portray assessment results; ensuring data collection accuracy; and focusing on clear and unambiguous display presentations designed to achieve actionable results.

• Possess a bachelor’s degree in business intelligence analysis, statistics, engineering, or related field.

Additional skills for the highly qualified candidate:

• Demonstrated qualities of strong attention to detail; critical thinking, creative problem solving, data mining and visualization, predicative analysis, machine learning, high accuracy of products; and communication skills to relate to senior officers during assessment interviews.

Description
The Ascendancy Group’s Mission To be the unequaled provider of special operations forces (SOF) and Intelligence Community focused technical, service, and training-based solutions. Opportunity Join The Ascendancy Group (TAG) in supporting the Naval Special Warfare (NSW) Leader Assessment Program (NLAP), a program that helps prepare future NSW leaders through fair, transparent competency assessment evolutions and professional-development opportunities. This full-time, on-site position is ideal for a data-driven professional who can turn complex assessment and operational data into clear, accurate, decision-ready insights. You will support the NLAP Program Manager, provide functional support during NLAP sessions, and lead the collection, analysis, visualization, and reporting of program data. Your work will help leadership understand participant performance, assessment trends, and opportunities to optimize NLAP operations. *This position is contingent upon contract award. Overview The Ascendancy Group is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst II to provide on-site business intelligence, data-analysis, reporting, dashboard-development, and assessment-program support for NLAP at Naval Amphibious Base Coronado, California. The Analyst will manage the flow of relevant data; develop models, reports, and visualizations; maintain data-collection processes; and communicate findings to technical and nontechnical NSW and Navy stakeholders. The Analyst will also supervise the Administrative Support Assistant assigned to this contract and may serve as the NLAP Moderator during panel milestone interviews when requested by the Government. The Moderator ensures continuity and adherence to approved interview scripts and rules of engagement; the Moderator does not assess participant milestone readiness. Security Requirement: An active U.S. Government Secret security clearance is required before the start date and must be maintained throughout employment. Roles and Responsibilities: • Collect business-intelligence data from NSW and NLAP sources. • Collaborate with program stakeholders to define key performance indicators, metrics, and data requirements; analyze, summarize, and route information to appropriate stakeholders on time. • Store and manage data in Government-controlled NLAP databases; establish operational procedures for database use and provide technical support as required. • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses and evaluations of NLAP operations and assessment processes to identify trends, assess effectiveness, and inform decision makers on optimization opportunities. • Apply regression algorithms, statistical software, and computer programs to support predictive modeling, classification, data normalization, and regularization. • Establish and maintain a user-friendly, interactive NLAP registration and peer/subordinate survey collection system. • Collect, process, and analyze large datasets from NLAP and the NSW Continuum of Leadership Development (CLD) program; coordinate with CLD personnel as directed by the NLAP Program Manager. • Develop and maintain complex data models, reports, dashboards, and visualizations using business intelligence tools such as Power BI and Tableau. • Create clear, compelling visual products that communicate findings to technical and nontechnical Navy and NSW audiences. • Remain aware of leadership-assessment trends across other Navy communities and incorporate relevant insights into program support. • Prepare and deliver quarterly NLAP analytic and performance reports by the last workday of each quarter, including participant-performance depictions, assessment-trend analysis, and data summaries. • Supervise and coordinate the work of the Administrative Support Assistant supporting NLAP. • Provide on-site functional support for NLAP sessions and ensure assigned PWS requirements are completed. • When requested, serve as NLAP Moderator during panel milestone interviews by following approved scripts, preparing for deliberations, enforcing rules of engagement, and maintaining situational awareness, discretion, tact, and continuity across NLAP iterations. • Safeguard classified and sensitive information and comply with applicable Department of War, Department of the Navy, USSOCOM, NSW, cybersecurity, privacy, and information-security requirements. • Support Government-directed training and authorized travel as required for NLAP activities. Requirements: • U.S. citizen with an active U.S. Government Secret security clearance required at start date. • Bachelor’s degree in business intelligence analysis, statistics, engineering, or a related field. • Minimum five years of experience developing customer-directed scoring and assessment templates or applications that are easy to use and provide real-time display capabilities. • Minimum five years of experience presenting performance summaries, analyzing performance trends, and developing future performance deliverables for assessment programs. • Demonstrated ability, in at least two instances, to understand collected data, conduct quantitative and/or qualitative analysis, and present summaries that facilitate executive decisions. • Demonstrated experience applying at least two data-collection best practices, including balancing stakeholder needs, maintaining accurate real-time data collection, using analytical tools to portray assessment results, ensuring data accuracy, or designing clear and actionable displays. • Experience with data mining, data visualization, predictive analysis, machine learning, regression methods, statistical software, and BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau. • Strong critical-thinking, creative problem-solving, communication, organization, and attention-to-detail skills. • Ability to communicate professionally with senior officers and other high-level stakeholders in a confidential assessment environment. • Ability to work full-time on site at Naval Amphibious Base Coronado, California, and obtain access to military installations. The Ascendancy Group (TAG) was founded on and thrives based on relationships, reputation, and trust. We are passionate about everything we do. One hundred percent of our government-focused teammates are former members of the Department of Defense or the Intelligence Community who still believe in supporting our nation. We offer like-minded individuals the opportunity to continue working in small teams on unique and challenging problem sets that further our nation's security. If you possess the experience, qualifications and drive required for this position, please APPLY NOW for consideration!
